space: metres; right-handed +Y; ground Y=0. +X advancing wave; +Z lateral.

wave.world_transform: W=(D(rest,coefficients)*scale-pivot) @ rotation.T + pivot + translation. Includes exact mesh support correction in translation.
wave.inverse: Untranslate, unpivot, inverse rotation, divide scale, analytic inverse local deformation. Sample REST density; never move density independently of its surface.
wave.controller: Analytic smoothstep authoring keys reproduce selected motion; LocalDeformation.f32 is an optional48Hz linear approximation, measured maximum fit error1.643mm.
wave.time: seconds; one shot; body local phase clamps0..3. No automatic looping or invented whole-body fade. Wave authoring/reference interval0..4.

landing.time: One-shot event seconds; remove puff outside its birth/lifetime; no solver; default seed13.
landing.appearance: Stable rest-coordinate3D dissolve; threshold changes with normalized age; exact hash/noise and edge width in shader/reference.
